title: Included-Miles Credit Amount on a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Free Move-In Contract
content:
**Billing clause — the included-miles credit of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental.**

The included-miles allowance is the class's free move-in included miles, as shown on the free move-in class terms, a whole number of miles. The credited miles are the miles charged on the contract's mileage line up to that allowance — that is, the smaller of the miles charged and the allowance — and the included-miles credit is the credited miles at the class per-mile rate, rounded to the cent once at the end.

The miles charged are the miles carried as the quantity of the contract's mileage charge line.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Bluegate Cargo Van contracts; included miles 50, per-mile rate 0.89)

| Miles charged on the mileage line | Allowance (miles) | Credited miles | Included-miles credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 72 | 50 | 50 | 44.50 |
| 50 | 50 | 50 | 44.50 |
| 31 | 50 | 31 | 27.59 |

The credit never exceeds the mileage charge itself, since the credited miles never exceed the miles charged.
